description: A stack of sections under headings, each heading a button that shows and hides the panel below it. Write one `ArenaAccordionItem` per section; ArenaAccordion owns which panels are open, the heading level and the keys between headers. `multiple` decides the mode and which pair of members is read.

content.description: The items. Which ones are open, the ids wiring each header to its panel and how a press is reported are the accordion's to settle. None of it is a member of an item. EVERY panel mounts: a closed one is hidden and keeps its content, so a panel's side effects run at first render.

multiple.description: Whether several panels may be open at once. False reads `value`, `defaultValue` and `valueChange`; true reads `values`, `defaultValues` and `valuesChange`. The pair of the other mode is ignored, and a set one is warned about once.

collapsible.description: Without `multiple`, whether the open panel may be closed again. False keeps it open once one is open, and its header writes aria-disabled. Nothing opens by itself: seed `defaultValue` to start with one open. Ignored with `multiple`, where every press toggles.

headingLevel.description: The rung each header's heading takes. The rung defaults to `h3`, the card's rung under a section's `h2`. `none` is refused at runtime, because each label names its panel and a header is a heading.

value.description: Without `multiple`, the open item's value, controlled. The empty string, or a value no item has, opens nothing. Omit it and pass `defaultValue` to let the accordion govern itself.

defaultValue.description: Without `multiple`, the item open at first render when uncontrolled. Absent, every panel starts closed.

valueChange.description: Without `multiple`, a header was pressed; carries the value of the item now open, or the empty string when the open one closed. Fired on a press only, never when a controlled `value` merely changes.

values.description: With `multiple`, the open items' values, controlled. A value no item has opens nothing. Omit it and pass `defaultValues` to let the accordion govern itself.

defaultValues.description: With `multiple`, the items open at first render when uncontrolled. Absent, every panel starts closed.

valuesChange.description: With `multiple`, a header was pressed; carries the whole set of open values that results, never a delta. Fired on a press only, never when controlled `values` merely change.
